what: On first open, the logo in the center of the background-color curtain opens from the left with clip, and the progress line below the curtain fills 0→1 over the same 3s (both curves start slow, go fast in the middle and drag out the end). Meanwhile the two words below alternate: the first word rises from 125% below over .6s with a .02 stagger per letter, rests .4s, then exits upward as the second word rises. After 3s the logo group turns off in .5s, the progress line withdraws to the right, and the curtain lifts up 101% in 1s. When done, fx:done is fired

options.dur: Logo open and progress line duration (s), default 3
options.delay: Delay before start (seconds), default 0 — the original Brand page starts .75s later, after its heavy scripts have all loaded
options.gap: Pause (s) after the opening ends until the logo group starts fading out, default 0 — Brand .5 (the second word drops at the end of the opening and the curtain lifts .5s later)

use: LogoJust a momentHello
note: Laying the same logo faintly under the logo (on the using side) shows the opening shape. Two words are needed for them to alternate

from.where: index.html .rc-loader — original initLogoRevealLoader: CustomEase loader 0.65,0.01,0.05,0.99, 3s, content .5s, curtain yPercent −101 1s, words .6/.4s stagger .02 (Logo Reveal Loader)

shared.js loader (.w-loader) — original jg(): CSS animation 2.8s cubic-bezier(.65,.01,.05,.99) for the bar · logo (outer −100%→0 · inner 100%→0, revealed from the left), first word delayed .6s, then .2s all at once from 125%. When full, the second word’s letters go −125% in .4s (.02), after .5s the content turns off over .5s · the bar withdraws to the right · the curtain goes −101% over 1s

index.html loader (.ld) — 3s ”loader” 0.65,0.01,0.05,0.99 for logo clip and progress line, two lines of letters with .02 stagger 125% → .6s, rest .4s then −125% .4s, group .5s, curtain −101% 1s. The original starts about 1.2s after the first paint (site script is received late)
